data.summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs held a kickoff meeting to start a pilot for the Nimbus Ledger Sync tool to automate UPI reconciliation. The team agreed on a scope limited strictly to UPI and set a target go-live date of Monday 30 November 2026.
decisions: Pilot go-live date is Monday 30 November 2026
Phase one is limited to UPI reconciliation only

follow_up_email.subject: Follow-up: Kickoff decisions and next steps
